name: Valdeverdeja (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over green with a white triangle at the hoist bearing a red Burgundy cross.
history: Municipal flag of Valdeverdeja; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
ragged Burgundy cross on the triangle
